learning_outcomes.text: Know the basic concepts of heat convection.
Solve heat transfer problems by convection on plane plate, cylindrical and spherical objects and on the tube bank.
Can solve external flow heat transfer problems.
Can solve natural convection heat transfer problems.
Make the thermal calculations of heat exchangers.
Knows the subject of basic radiation.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to convection. Equations of conservations. Velocity and thermal boundary layes.
Dimensionless parameters. Boundary layer similarity. Heat transfer in turbulent flow.
External forced convection. Drag force and heat transfer in external flow. Flow across cylinders and pressure drop.
Flow across spheres and tube banks. Pressure drop on tube banks.
Internal forced convection. Constant surface temperature and constant surface heat flux problems.
Naturel convection. Natural convection over vertical plates, inclined plates, horizontal cylinders and spheres.
General review of external forced convection and relations.
Heat exchangers. The overall heat transfer coefficient. The Log. Mean Temperature Diffenrence (LMTD) method.
Heat exchanger analysis: The Effectiveness–NTU Method. Pressure drop on heat exchanger.
Thermal radiation. Fundamental Concepts. Blackbody Radiation. Absorption, re?ection, and transmission by real surfaces. The Gray Surface.
Radiation exchange between surfaces. The view factor. Radiation shields.
